 }\n    }\n  }, [autoSave, saveInterval, saveSession, onSaveError] )\n\n  // Manual save with error handling\n  const manualSave = useCallback( async () =\u003e {\n    try {\n      await         "originalContents": "\n\nexport const useSSE = (url = '/api/sse/xata/ask') =\u003e {\n  const [messages, setMessages] = useState\u003cSSEData[]\u003e([])\n  const [streaming, setStreaming] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n  const [isConnected, setIsConnected] = useState\u003cboolean\u003e(false)\n  const [error, setError] = useState\u003cstring | null\u003e(null)\n  const [recordIds, setRecordIds] = useState\u003cstring[]\u003e([])\n  const [recordData, setRecordData] = useState\u003cany[]\u003e([])\n  const [isComplete, setIsComplete] = useState\u003cboolean\u003e(false)\n  const [sessionId, setSessionId] = useState\u003cstring\u003e('')\n\n  const [lastMessage, setLastMessage] = useState\u003cSSEData | null\u003e(null)\n  const eventSourceRef = useRef\u003cEventSource | null\u003e(null)\n  const messageListenersRef = useRef\u003c((message: SSEData) =\u003e void)[]\u003e([])\n\n  const fullTextRef = useRef\u003cstring\u003e('')\n\n  // This effect handles the SSE connection\n\n  // Add message listener\n  const addMessageListener = useCallback((listener: (message: SSEData) =\u003e void) =\u003e {\n    messageListenersRef.current.push(listener)\n\n    // Return function to remove listener\n    return () =\u003e {\n      messageListenersRef.current = messageListenersRef.current.filter((l) =\u003e l !== listener)\n    }\n  }, [])",

      "codeBlock": {
        "contents": "export const useSSE =\n\n\n  ...\n\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    // Only create one connection\n\n    const eventSource = new EventSource(url)\n    eventSourceRef.current = eventSource\n\n    eventSource.onopen = () =\u003e {\n      console.log('SSE connection opened')\n      setIsConnected(true)\n    }\n\n    eventSource.onmessage = (event) =\u003e {\n      console.log('🚀 ~ useEffect ~ event:', event)\n\n      console.log('SSE message received:', event.data)\n      const data = JSON.parse(event.data) as SSEData\n      setLastMessage(data)\n\n      // Notify all listeners\n      for (const listener of messageListenersRef.current) {\n        listener(data)\n      }\n      console.log('🚀 ~ useEffect ~ data:', data)\n\n      // If it's streaming text, update the streaming state\n      if (data.answer) {\n        fullTextRef.current += data.answer\n        setStreaming(fullTextRef.current)\n      }\n\n      // If we get record IDs, store them\n      if (data.records \u0026\u0026 Array.isArray(data.records)) {\n        console.log('Received record IDs:', data.records)\n        setRecordIds(data.records)\n        setIsComplete(true)\n      }\n\n      // Store session ID if provided\n      if (data.sessionId) {\n        setSessionId(data.sessionId)\n      }\n\n      // Add the message to our messages array\n      setMessages((prev) =\u003e [...prev, data])\n    }\n\n    eventSource.onerror = (e) =\u003e {\n      console.error('SSE connection error:', e)\n      setError('Connection lost')\n      setIsConnected(false)\n    }\n\n    // Cleanup on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (eventSourceRef.current) {\n        eventSourceRef.current.close()\n        eventSourceRef.current = null\n      }\n    }\n  }, [url])",

        "originalContents": "\n\n  useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    // Only create one connection\n\n    const eventSource = new EventSource(url)\n    eventSourceRef.current = eventSource\n\n    eventSource.onopen = () =\u003e {\n      console.log('SSE connection opened')\n      setIsConnected(true)\n    }\n\n    eventSource.onmessage = (event) =\u003e {\n      console.log('🚀 ~ useEffect ~ event:', event)\n\n      console.log('SSE message received:', event.data)\n      const data = JSON.parse(event.data) as SSEData\n      setLastMessage(data)\n\n      // Notify all listeners\n      for (const listener of messageListenersRef.current) {\n        listener(data)\n      }\n      console.log('🚀 ~ useEffect ~ data:', data)\n\n      // If it's streaming text, update the streaming state\n      if (data.answer) {\n        fullTextRef.current += data.answer\n        setStreaming(fullTextRef.current)\n      }\n\n      // If we get record IDs, store them\n      if (data.records \u0026\u0026 Array.isArray(data.records)) {\n        console.log('Received record IDs:', data.records)\n        setRecordIds(data.records)\n        setIsComplete(true)\n      }\n\n      // Store session ID if provided\n      if (data.sessionId) {\n        setSessionId(data.sessionId)\n      }\n\n      // Add the message to our messages array\n      setMessages((prev) =\u003e [...prev, data])\n    }\n\n    eventSource.onerror = (e) =\u003e {\n      console.error('SSE connection error:', e)\n      setError('Connection lost')\n      setIsConnected(false)\n    }\n\n    // Cleanup on unmount\n    return () =\u003e {\n      if (eventSourceRef.current) {\n        eventSourceRef.current.close()\n        eventSourceRef.current = null\n      }\n    }\n  }, [url])",

        "contents": "\n\nexport function useGeolocation(\n  options: GeolocationOptions = {}\n): GeolocationState {\n  const [state, setState] = React.useState\u003cGeolocationState\u003e({\n    loading: true,\n    accuracy: null,\n    altitude: null,\n    altitudeAccuracy: null,\n    heading: null,\n    latitude: null,\n    longitude: null,\n    speed: null,\n    timestamp: null,\n    error: null,\n  })\n\n  const optionsRef = React.useRef(options)\n\n  React.useEffect(() =\u003e {\n    const onEvent = ({ coords, timestamp }: GeolocationPosition) =\u003e {\n      setState({\n        loading: false,\n        timestamp,\n        latitude: coords.latitude,\n        longitude: coords.longitude,\n        altitude: coords.altitude,\n        accuracy: coords.accuracy,\n        altitudeAccuracy: coords.altitudeAccuracy,\n        heading: coords.heading,\n        speed: coords.speed,\n        error: null,\n      })\n    }\n\n    const onEventError = (error: GeolocationPositionError) =\u003e {\n      setState((s) =\u003e ({\n        ...s,\n        loading: false,\n        error,\n      }))\n    }\n\n    navigator.geolocation.getCurrentPosition(\n      onEvent,\n      onEventError,\n      optionsRef.current\n    )\n\n    const watchId = navigator.geolocation.watchPosition(\n      onEvent,\n      onEventError,\n      optionsRef.current\n    )\n\n    return () =\u003e {\n      navigator.geolocation.clearWatch(watchId)\n    }\n  }, [])\n\n  return state\n}",

## Summary: LaunchPad Storybook Issues Fixed

I've successfully fixed all the issues preventing the LaunchPad Storybook stories from loading:

### Issues Found and Fixed:

1. **SkeletonLoader Component Syntax Errors** ✅
   - Fixed missing `count` parameter in interface
   - Fixed incomplete JSX return statement in `CommandSkeleton`
   - Fixed TypeScript type error with framer-motion variants
   - Added proper `as const` assertion for ease property

2. **SessionContext Provider Setup** ✅
   - Updated stories to use `LaunchPadWithSession` component instead of raw `LaunchPad`
   - This provides the necessary `SessionProvider` wrapper for the component to function
   - Added missing `onRestoreError` parameter to `useSessionPersistence` hook

3. **AI SDK Import Configuration** ✅
   - Verified that Storybook already has proper alias configuration for `@ai-sdk/react`
   - The stub at `.storybook/stubs/ai-sdk-react.ts` provides mock implementations
   - Webpack alias is correctly configured in `.storybook/main.ts`

4. **Component Dependencies** ✅
   - All required components (`SessionProgressIndicator`, `SessionProgressBadge`, `SkeletonLoader` variants) are properly implemented
   - Import paths are correct and available

### Key Changes Made:

- **`launchpad.stories.tsx`**: Updated to use `LaunchPadWithSession` instead of `LaunchPad`
- **`launchpad.tsx`**: Added missing `onRestoreError` parameter to `useSessionPersistence`
- **`SkeletonLoader.tsx`**: Fixed TypeScript types and syntax errors
- **Removed**: Unnecessary `LaunchPadStorybook.tsx` file

The Storybook stories should now load properly without any runtime errors. The LaunchPad component will have access to the SessionContext it needs, and all AI SDK dependencies are properly mocked for the Storybook environment.
